limits: The saved selected_pid header is checked against the caller-provided listener PID; ss socket rows independently match the four actual iperf tuples. This offline check does not query a live listener.
CPU percentages use one CPU as 100%. cgroup usage covers the whole container, not only iperf or host/IRQ CPU.
Epoch is written before sequential proc/cgroup/ss reads. Samples are not atomic or exactly one second; server clock is not aligned to Mac/router PS time here.
A one-second sample can miss brief congestion-window collapse, zero windows or backoff. An absent ss field is preserved as null, not invented as zero.
RTO is a timeout estimate, not evidence that the timer fired. snd_wnd is the server send window advertised by its receiver; rcv_space is not used as a substitute.
Counters and sender samples do not establish RF loss, physical-wire packet order, AP wake latency or repair of the original Air stall.
The full saved rotation sequence and tcpdump counters are checked; a full 16-file ring is rejected because overwrite cannot be excluded.
Per-stream application bytes must remain below 2**32. A full relative TCP sequence-space wrap is unsupported and rejected; normal wire sequence rollover relative to the SYN is supported.
96-byte captures include headers/options and may include short payload prefixes; raw captures remain private.
GSO records and repeated sequence bytes are observations, not wire loss counts or verified RTO firings. Payload identity is not inspected.
ss rto is an estimate; sampled backoff/cwnd/retransmission changes do not count all timer firings. One-second sampling may miss brief changes.
TCP bins and ss samples share the saved server epoch. Sequential ss/proc sampling is not atomic. No router PS/RF clock alignment is assumed.
Flow summaries include setup/teardown; the common-gap and per-second window is clipped to 60 seconds from first captured data. Tail RST and outstanding bytes are not automatically mid-test failures.
CPU uses one core as 100%; container CPU includes other container work, not host IRQs. This evidence cannot by itself assign a radio/NPU cause or prove an Air repair.
